sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Rocoto pepper is an Andean perennial subshrub or shrub, often about 1–3 m tall. Its stems and leaves are pubescent; flowers are purple with purple anthers, and the mature seeds are dark. Fruit shape and colour vary among cultivated forms.

sections.title: Food and image
sections.text: The fruits are eaten as peppers and can be pungent. The plate's hairy foliage, purple flower and dark seeds distinguish this species from many common peppers, including C. annuum; its cut fruit and colour are only one cultivar-like form.
